episode_start.description: There is an action coming from /cmd_xela

terminal.description: The episode has been terminated because a success or failure condition has been met
terminal.source: JEV detecting the success or failure condition

truncated.description: The episode has been truncated because the maximum number of steps has been reached
truncated.source: Maximum number of steps reached (maybe a timer being published on a topic)

success.description: The episode has been terminated because a success condition has been met. The tip of the pen can be seen fully on the camera feed
success.source: JEV detecting the success  which is the tip of the pen being visible on the camera feed

fell_off.description: The pen has fallen off the palm of the hand
fell_off.source: JEV detecting the pen falling off the palm of the hand

slipping.description: The pen is slipping on the palm of the hand
slipping.source: JEV detecting the pen slipping on the palm of the hand

flying.description: The pen is flying in the air
flying.source: JEV detecting the pen flying in the air

fingers_touching_pen.description: The fingers (MF or IF or RF) are touching the pen
fingers_touching_pen.source: Haptic feedback from the pen to the fingers

Thumb_has_found_the_pen.description: The thumb has found the pen
Thumb_has_found_the_pen.source: JEV and Haptic feedback from the pen to the thumb

Thumb_is_clicking_the_pen.description: The thumb is clicking the pen
Thumb_is_clicking_the_pen.source: JEV detecting the thumb clicking the pen

Thumb_has_clicked_the_pen.description: The thumb has clicked the pen
Thumb_has_clicked_the_pen.source: JEV detecting the thumb clicking the pen
